subject: Re: Q4 inference pilot — pivoting off roadmap

Cc: procurement@northbridge.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 inference pilot — kickoff demo (calendar invite enclosed)

Hi Liam —

Thanks for locking in time with us next Tuesday for the technical kickoff/demo. Attached is a short SOW draft and the internal agenda we planned to run through (30 min demo + 15 min Q&A).

Quick notes:
- Demo will focus on inference latency/cost tradeoffs and a short walkthrough of Redwood Dedicated options.
- If you prefer a sandbox link instead of a live demo, we can do that too.

Attached: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (outline, pricing bands).

Looking forward — let me know if any execs need a different time.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0172

From: Liam O'Rourke <liam.orourke@northbridge.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@northbridge.ai
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 inference pilot — kickoff demo (calendar invite enclosed)

Thanks Stephanie — appreciate the materials and the calendar invite. Quick update from our side:

We're going to deprioritize the inference pilot for the remainder of Q3. A couple of drivers:
- Our product roadmap just shifted toward a major analytics re-platform; engineering resources are being reallocated for the next two quarters.
- Execs have travel and a board planning window in July that complicates any new vendor commitments.
- Procurement has a hiring freeze until budget re-approval; they asked us to pause active contracts/DocuSign steps.

Can we park the demo for now and revisit in early Q4? I'm happy to re-open when we have clarity — please keep the materials on file and remove the SOW from any active signing queue for the moment.

Apologies for the churn; not a reflection on Redwood — timing is the issue.

— Liam
Liam O'Rourke
VP Product
Northbridge AI
liam.orourke@northbridge.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NB-2027-014 — prospect deprioritized (suggested next steps)

Stephanie / Marissa —

Saw Liam's note. Short thoughts on how we should handle this so we keep the deal alive without burning resources:

1) Acknowledge and pause: confirm we pulled the SOW from DocuSign and removed active reminders.
2) Offer a lightweight ‘reengage playbook’: a one-pager for when they are ready (Q4 touchpoints, checklist for infra ramp, typical cost/latency baselines). We can reuse material from the demo slide deck.
3) Suggest a tentative Q4 checkpoint: propose a week in the first half of October for a 15-min health check (no live demo required).
4) Keep them in nurture with a single monthly note (product update + one customer benchmark relevant to their use-case).

If we want to be slightly more aggressive, we can offer a $X credit for a future pilot (sales approval required). That might keep them as a warm prospect without immediate spend.

What do you want me to commit to now? I can pull the DocuSign link and update HubSpot stage to "Paused - Customer Priority".

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, East
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Rourke <liam.orourke@northbridge.ai>
Cc: procurement@northbridge.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q4 inference pilot — pivoting off roadmap

Hi Liam — thanks for the quick update and for the context. Totally understand — calendar and roadmap pressure are real. We have:

- Removed SOW-draft-v1.pdf from DocuSign and canceled reminders.
- Updated the HubSpot deal NB-2027-014 to "Paused - Customer Priority" and set a reminder for the first week of October to reconnect.
- I've attached a 1-page re-engagement checklist (no heavy lift) that you can share internally when the team is ready.

If it helps, we can tentatively propose three 15-minute windows the week of Oct 4th — that keeps it low-bandwidth. Otherwise, ping me when you have clarity and we'll re-open the calendar.

No need to take further action on your side. Hope the analytics re-platform goes smoothly — send any questions in the meantime.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
